key.name: clock-language
key.description: Language used for the weekday and month shown in the panel clock.

key.name: clock-time-format
key.description: Use a 12-hour clock with AM/PM or a 24-hour clock.

key.name: panel-icon-size
key.description: Base icon size in logical pixels, scaled with the panel height.

key.name: panel-icon-spacing
key.description: Target horizontal gap between neighboring panel icons in logical pixels.

key.name: spotlight-shortcut
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut used to open or close Spotlight. Set to an empty string to disable it.

key.name: control-center-shortcut
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut used to open or close Control Center. Set to an empty string to disable it.

key.name: adopted-toggles
key.description: Titles of the Quick Settings toggles that were added to the control center through the "Edit Controls" picker.

key.name: custom-layout
key.summary: Position and size of custom controls
key.description: One JSON object per custom control, giving its column, row, column span and row span in the four-column custom grid.

key.name: hidden-builtins
key.summary: Built-in modules kept out of the panel
key.description: Ids of the panel's own modules that the user removed with the "Edit Controls" picker or the minus badge of arrange mode.
